My name is Ayush Chandra and I am in 9th grade at Sharon High School. You find my work on [GitHub](https://github.com/SmartSilver5294) or contact me at [chandra.ayush2021@gmail.com](chandra.ayush2021@gmail.com).

My project is about the average cost of paying for gas versus paying for charging over a 3 year period in the US. It also includes comparisons between different EVs and their gas counterparts. The code and data are available at the [Github Repo](https://github.com/SmartSilver5294/ev-vs-gas-costs).

This site was created for [Kane's Data Science Bootcamp](https://bootcamp.davidkane.info/).
